rationale: Moe is building AI agent and LLM tooling products with a strong technical foundation in Python and TypeScript, while Anshu is deeply focused on AI agent safety and security—a critical gap in the AI tooling ecosystem. Anshu's expertise in securing AI systems and agents, combined with his conviction that LLMs can be weaponized and that security frameworks are essential for safe deployment, directly complements Moe's work on developer-facing AI tools. This is a natural fit for exploring how security and safety can be architected into the next generation of AI agent products from the ground up.
intro_message: Moe, meet Anshu Gupta — he's building security frameworks for AI agents and LLM systems at Fixin Security, and given your focus on AI-agent and LLM tooling, his perspective on agent safety could be directly valuable to your product.
